newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia to auction shops, services in February.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia to auction shops, services in February.

text.p: Mongolian government will privatise at least 129 shops, services and buildings in the capital, Ulan Bator, beginning on February 1, the State Privatisation Committee said on Tuesday.
"Foreigners are allowed to participate and to buy in the auction," the committee spokesman said in an interview.
The government had named 66 shops and 36 separate shopping centres and industrial buildings for auction in February, a list issued by the Privatisation Committee said.
The list also contained 23 other buildings and complexes as well as nine cinemas, two hotels, several restaurants and other service units such as public baths and car parks.
Prime Minister M. Enkhsaikhan said recently Mongolia planned to push ahead with large-scale privatisations in Mongolia.
The government had introduced a list of state buildings, diplomatic residences and public utilities that should not be privatised, the Montsame news agency said.
